title: GIRDER FAME owner report on frame damage and replacement (2024-04)
publisher: XHS public post; publisher authority unverified
notes: One owner reports buying a FAME with a full carbon frame, marble-pattern carbon wheels and a Shimano Ultegra-level group at a physical shop in summer 2023, riding more than 2,000 km in about eight months, then cracking the carbon frame by over-tightening the seat-post clamp without a torque wrench. The owner says the shop first declined warranty, and the brand's after-sales team then replaced the frame free of charge and returned the rebuilt bike within about a day. This is one uncorroborated historical account with a self-described cause and no independent diagnosis. It is not evidence of defect frequency, causation by design, or current warranty terms. The exact Ultegra series and frame generation are not stated. Personal route, identity and contact details are not retained.

reference_claims.claim: One 2024 FAME owner reports a free frame replacement from GIRDER after-sales following self-described seat-clamp over-tightening damage.
reference_claims.limitations: Single community report; no defect-rate, causal or current-warranty-policy conclusion. Confirm warranty issuer and terms with the exact current dealer.
